I’m happy you’re keeping track of your subscriptions! Unfortunately I don’t have direct access to your personal calendar or reminders, so I can’t create the note myself. Here’s a quick way to set it up yourself: | Platform | Steps | |----------|-------| | **iOS / macOS** | 1️⃣ Open *Reminders*.
2️⃣ Tap “+ New Reminder”.
3️⃣ Title: `Netflix Subscription Renewal`.
4️⃣ Set due date to **March 27**, choose “Alert” → “At time of event.” | | **Android** | 1️⃣ Use Google Keep or Google Tasks.
2️⃣ Create new note/task titled `Netflix Subscription Renewal`.
3️⃣ Add a date‑and‑time alarm for March 27 at whatever hour works for you. | | **Windows/Mac Calendar** | 1️⃣ Open Outlook or Calendar app.
2️⃣ Create a new event named `Renew Netflix Sub`.
3️⃣ Date: March 27; Time: e.g., 9 AM.
4️⃣ Turn on a notification/alarm. | | **Web services** | If you use Todoist, Trello, Notion, etc., simply add a task/card dated March 27 with a comment reminding you to renew. | If you’d like, let me know which device/service you prefer and I’ll walk through those exact steps—or even draft a short text snippet you can copy into your chosen app.
